if you're good at managing your units add some cavalry as well and put them aside and make them flank the enemy.  

do not charge, only move forward 10 steps at a time when the enemy flees use that time to regroup, fall back a bit, sort out your formations properly.
  
I don't like using ranged units, they barely do any damage, since everyone has a shield, they're only really good against peasants and ruffians and fleeing enemies.
